title: 第8章  震惊所有长辈
content_zh:
四目相对，时间，似乎静止在了这一刻。
所有人，都有些懵逼！
好一会，有人发出了悲呛的怒吼。
“南儿！不，这是怎么回事！”
怒吼的，是一位中年。
这是楚弛的四伯父，楚寻意，楚南的亲生父亲。
“寻意，你怎么也从外面回来的？这么说，猛虎拳大成的，不是你？”
楚山皱起了眉头。
按照他的猜测，大成猛虎拳的，只会是儿子这一辈。
楚寻意没有回答，他快速去到楚南身边，仔细打量了楚南的身体后，他更加愤怒了！
“谁干的，是谁干的。谁这么残忍，不仅打断了我儿手脚，还将他弄成这样！”
他的话落，楚弛淡淡回答道：“我。”
“是你？不可能！”
楚寻意明显不相信。
楚弛不过凡人境三层，怎么可能打断楚南的手脚！
这时，楚枫开口道：“四伯父，的确是楚弛。”
这一瞬间，现场所有长辈的目光，全部集中在楚弛身上。
每个人的眼神，都很诧异。
“楚枫，你确定是他？”
“嗯，他将猛虎拳大成了！”

“什么！”
这语落，全场皆惊。
猛虎拳，虽然只是人级中品。但想要将之大成，也非常不容易。
整个楚家，将猛虎拳大成的，不超过双手之数，而且，都是长辈。
楚山也是在修为提升到凡人境六层后，用了五年，才将猛虎拳大成。
楚弛一个小辈，居然大成了猛虎拳？
震惊之后，楚山询问道：“楚弛，你什么时候学的猛虎拳？”
楚弛咧嘴一笑，装逼一般地道：“昨晚。”
昨晚，楚弛本来只打算学《七剑斩》。
但他没想到，得了女剑仙的剑道传承，他修炼剑技的速度，快到爆！
只是很短的时间，他就掌握了前面五剑。
至于后面的两剑，不是他掌握不了，而是他修为太弱，不足以施展出最后两剑。
所以后半夜，他开始修炼另外两本人级中品武技。
其中一本，就是猛虎拳。
原本楚弛以为，修炼拳法，速度就慢了。
但他万万没想到，速度不仅不慢，反而更快。
在修炼拳法的时候《大道自然诀》，自动浮现在脑海里。
这无上功法，似乎能让他修炼武技，事半功倍。
掌握自然诀，一切自然而然！
一个晚上，他就将猛虎拳大成了。

当然，这也同猛虎拳等级不高，只是微末小技有关系。
“昨晚？胡扯！一个晚上，你能将猛虎拳大成？”
家族的长辈，明显不相信！
就算是武道奇才，也不可能一晚上就将武技大成吧？
长辈们还想问些什么，楚寻意的声音传来了。
“楚弛，原来是你！都是一家人，你何以下手如此狠！”
楚寻意双眼发红，双拳紧握！
虽然他身为长辈，却也忍不住要出手教训楚弛了。
闻言，楚弛忍不住笑了：“一家人？当年他将我推下粪坑的时候，你们不是这样说的，甚至，根本没有人管我死活。现在告诉我，一家人？”
“这么说，你是故意下狠手的！”
“当然是故意的。谁让他，欺我平凡，谁让他，辱我尊严。
我就是要告诉他，该还的，迟早都要还！”
楚弛声音铿锵，眼神无畏。
他等这一天，等得太久了！
“楚南，如果不服，随时来挑战我。但，一日手下败将，终生手下败将。你，只是一个失败者。从今以后，你只配仰望我！”
“够了，你太放肆了。既然你从小没爹妈管，我这个当伯父的，就来管教管教你！”
楚寻意一声怒吼。
他忍不了了！
虽然长辈出手欺负晚辈，是很没有脸面的事情。
但天下当父母的，谁能眼睁睁看见自己儿女受到伤害？

这个楚弛，太嚣张了。
出手如此狠，就算了，居然不知道悔改。
楚寻意体绽灵光，凡人境七层的气势，蜂拥而出。
这气势，让现场凡人境四层及其以下的修者，全部双腿发软，跪在了地上。
修者之间，三层一道坎。
但楚弛，依旧站立如松，不动如钟。
他眼神冷傲地道：“我是没有父母管，但不意味着，你就有资格管我。你以为你是谁？”
“你！野孩子就是野孩子，一点都不尊重长辈，该好好教训！”
楚寻意脸色非常冷，已经准备出手了。
楚弛却是一点都不慌，转头看了楚山一眼。
就在楚寻意准备动手的时候，楚山开口了。
“够了！长辈对小辈出手，成何体统？说出去，也让人笑话。”
“爹，可是南儿他……”
“你别忘了，这场约战，是楚南自己答应的。你赶紧将他带回去，接好断骨，用药温养。好了，你们也散去，别看热闹了，楚弛，你跟我来。”
话落，楚山抓住楚弛的肩膀，快速离开了院子。
路上，楚山冷哼了一声，开口道：“你小子，怎么知道我要维护你？”
楚弛眼神平淡地道：“我是年轻一辈中，唯一一个将猛虎拳大成的人。你这都不维护我，那得多愚蠢。”
“你是在变相骂我？”
“不敢不敢。”
楚山哼了一声，继续道：“你当真大成了猛虎拳？”

楚弛二话不说，隔空打出一拳。
拳声，犹如虎啸。
楚山眼神一眯，眼里有精光。
好一会他开口道：“楚弛，你打伤楚南的事情，我可以护着你。我保证，寻意不会再追究，但你老实告诉我，你是不是得到了什么了不得机缘？不然，你怎么忽然成为了修者，还拥有了如此逆天的天赋。”
楚弛思考了一下，道：“爷爷，我也不瞒你。我坠下山崖，遇到了一位身受重伤的绝世强者。是他救了我，并且助我成为了修者。”
“遇到了绝世强者？居然有这等机缘？那他有没有传授你绝世功法或者神通秘术？”楚山眼里有光。
楚弛摇了摇头道：“没有。如果有的话，我何须修炼猛虎拳？”
“可惜，可惜了。”
楚山不停叹气，好一会才道。
“你打伤楚南的事情，无须担心。我保证，没人去找你麻烦。”
“这么说，我终于得到你的认可了。果然，在这个世界，想要得到别人认可，只有变强。”
楚弛的声音，明显有些自嘲。
“爷爷，要是没其他事，那我回去继续修炼了。”
“嗯，去吧，我待会也要出村，亲自送一批货物。楚弛，努力吧，你要是能成为我楚家青年最强，我保证，你在楚家的地位，没人能比！我还会给你一个惊喜。”
“青年最强？这有何难？”
楚弛将手放在后脑袋，潇洒离去。
content_en:
Their eyes met, and time seemed to stand still at this moment.
Everyone is a little confused!
After a while, someone let out a sad and angry roar.
"Nan'er! No, what's going on!"
The one roaring was a middle-aged man.
This is Chu Chi's fourth uncle, Chu Xunyi, Chu Nan's biological father.
"Xunyi, why did you come back from outside? So you're not the one who mastered the Tiger Fist?"
Chu Shan frowned.
According to his guess, only his son's generation will succeed in the Tiger Fist.
Chu Xunyi didn't answer. He quickly went to Chu Nan's side. After carefully looking at Chu Nan's body, he became even more angry!
"Who did it, who did it? Who was so cruel, not only broke my son's hands and feet, but also made him like this!"
After he finished speaking, Chu Chi replied calmly: "Me."
"Is it you? Impossible!"
Chu Xunyi obviously didn't believe it.
Chu Chi was only at the third level of the mortal realm, how could he possibly interrupt Chu Nan's hands and feet!
At this time, Chu Feng said: "Fourth uncle is indeed Chu Chi."
At this moment, the eyes of all the elders present were focused on Chu Chi.
Everyone's eyes were very surprised.
"Chu Feng, are you sure it's him?"
"Well, he perfected the Tiger Fist!"
"What!"
As soon as these words fell, the whole audience was shocked.
Tiger Fist, although it is only a mid-level human level. But it is not easy to achieve it.
In the entire Chu family, there are no more than two hands who can master the Tiger Fist, and they are all elders.
It took Chu Shan five years to master the Tiger Fist after his cultivation reached the sixth level of the mortal realm.
Chu Chi, a junior, actually became a master of Tiger Fist?
After being shocked, Chu Shan asked: "Chu Chi, when did you learn Tiger Fist?"
Chu Chi grinned and said in a pretentious manner: "Last night."
Last night, Chu Chi originally planned to learn "Seven Swordsmanship".
But he didn't expect that with the inheritance of swordsmanship from the female swordsman, he would be able to practice sword skills at an explosive speed!
In just a short time, he mastered the first five swords.
As for the next two swords, it's not that he can't master them, it's that his cultivation is too weak to use the last two swords.
So in the middle of the night, he began to practice two other mid-level human-level martial arts.
One of them is Tiger Fist.
Originally, Chu Chi thought that practicing boxing would be slow.
But he never expected that not only was the speed not slow, but it was faster.
When practicing boxing, "The Natural Technique of the Great Dao" automatically comes to mind.
This supreme skill seems to allow him to practice martial arts with twice the result with half the effort.
Master the secret of nature and everything will come naturally!
In one night, he mastered the Tiger Fist.
Of course, this is also related to the fact that the level of Tiger Fist is not high and it is just a minor skill.
"Last night? Nonsense! Can you master the Tiger Fist in one night?"
The elders of the family obviously don’t believe it!
Even if you are a martial arts wizard, you can't master martial arts overnight, right?
What else did the elders want to ask, and Chu Xunyi's voice came.
"Chu Chi, it turns out to be you! We are all a family, why are you so cruel!"
Chu Xunyi's eyes were red and his fists were clenched!
Although he was an elder, he couldn't help but teach Chu Chi a lesson.
Hearing this, Chu Chi couldn't help but laugh: "A family? That's not what you said when he pushed me down the pit. In fact, no one cared about my life or death at all. Now tell me, a family?"
"So, you were cruel on purpose!"
"Of course he did it on purpose. Who told him to bully me into being ordinary? Who told him to insult my dignity?
I just want to tell him that he must pay back what he deserves sooner or later! "
Chu Chi's voice was sonorous and his eyes were fearless.
He has been waiting for this day for too long!
"Chu Nan, if you don't accept it, come and challenge me at any time. However, once you lose a general, you will always lose a general. You are just a loser. From now on, you only deserve to look up to me!"
"Enough, you are too presumptuous. Since you have neverYou have no parents to take care of you, so I, as your uncle, will discipline you! "
Chu Xunyi roared angrily.
He can't bear it anymore!
Although it is very shameful for elders to bully younger generations.
But among the parents in the world, who can watch their children being harmed?
This Chu Chi is too arrogant.
The attack was so ruthless, but he didn't know how to repent.
Chu Xunyi's body glowed with spiritual light, and the aura of the seventh level of the mortal realm swarmed out.
This momentum made all cultivators present at the fourth level of mortal realm and below have their legs weak and kneel on the ground.
There are three levels and one hurdle between cultivators.
But Chu Chi still stood like a pine, motionless like a bell.
His eyes were cold and arrogant as he said: "I don't have parents to take care of me, but that doesn't mean you are qualified to take care of me. Who do you think you are? "
"you! Wild children are wild children and have no respect for their elders at all. They should be taught a lesson! "
Chu Xunyi's face was very cold and he was ready to take action.
Chu Chi was not panicked at all, and turned to look at Chu Shan.
Just when Chu Xunyi was about to take action, Chu Shan spoke.
"Enough! How is it appropriate for an elder to take action against a junior? If you tell it, it will make people laugh. "
"Dad, but Nan'er..."
"Don't forget, Chu Nan himself agreed to this fight. You quickly take him back, repair the broken bones, and use medicine to warm him up. Okay, you guys should disperse and stop watching the excitement. Chu Chi, come with me. "
As soon as he finished speaking, Chu Shan grabbed Chu Chi's shoulders and quickly left the yard.
On the way, Chu Shan snorted coldly and said: "You kid, how do you know that I want to protect you? "
Chu Chi's eyes were flat and he said: "I am the only one among the younger generation who has mastered Tiger Fist. How stupid you are if you don't even defend me. "
"Are you scolding me in disguise? "
"Don't dare. "
Chu Shan snorted and continued: "Are you really the master of Tiger Fist? "
Without saying a word, Chu Chi punched him in the air.
The sound of the fist was like the roar of a tiger.
Chu Shan's eyes narrowed, and there was a sparkle in his eyes.
After a while, he said: "Chu Chi, I can protect you when you hurt Chu Nan. I promise that Xunyi will not pursue it again, but tell me honestly, did you get any incredible opportunity? Otherwise, how could you suddenly become a cultivator and possess such an incredible talent? "
Chu Chi thought for a moment and said, "Grandpa, I won't hide it from you either. I fell off the cliff and met a peerless strong man who was seriously injured. It was he who saved me and helped me become a practitioner. "
"Meet a peerlessly powerful person? There is such an opportunity? Then did he teach you peerless skills or magical powers? "There was light in Chushan's eyes.
Chu Chi shook his head and said: "No. If so, why should I practice Tiger Fist? "
“What a pity, what a pity. "
Chu Shan kept sighing and said after a while.
"There is no need to worry about you hurting Chu Nan. I promise, no one will bother you. "
"So, I finally have your approval. Sure enough, in this world, if you want to be recognized by others, you can only become stronger. "
Chu Chi's voice was obviously self-deprecating.
"Grandpa, if there is nothing else, I will go back and continue practicing. "
"Well, go ahead, I will leave the village later and deliver a batch of goods myself. Chu Chi, work hard. If you can become the strongest young man in my Chu family, I guarantee that your status in the Chu family will be unmatched by anyone! I will also give you a surprise. "
"Youth is the strongest? How difficult is this? "
Chu Chi put his hands on the back of his head and left gracefully.
